title: Ergonomic DLQ operator endpoints: browse + redrive/replay dead-letters
body: Dead-lettered messages are currently only visible by querying the journal directly. An operator needs to see what is stuck and put it back: browse the dead-letter queue for a subscription with paging, inspect a message's payload and failure reason, and redrive selected messages (or all of them) back onto the subscription for another delivery attempt. Replay should be idempotent and must not disturb in-flight delivery.
